A RESOLUTION PRECLUDING THE RENTAL OR USE OF
THECITY'S ATHLETIC FIELDS BY STEVE AVILA OR S A A
ENTERPRISES UNTIL THOSE PARTIES HAVE REPAID THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE AND CHEYENNE MUSTANGS
BASEBALL FOR ALL LOSSES SUSTAINED FROM THE2017
CAB A WORLD SERIES TOURNAMENT.
WHEREAS, in 2017 the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming (the “City") and Cheyenne
Competitive Baseball Association, d/b/a Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball ("Cheyenne Mustangs
Baseball') entered into an arrangement with Steve Avila and his company, SAA Enterprises,
LLC, tohost a Continental Amateur Baseball Association("CABA")18U wood bat world series
tournament (the“2017 Tournament") to be held in Cheyenne, Wyoming on August 4, 2017
through August 12,2017; and
WHEREAS, the City invested$50,000.00towards the cost of the2017Tour ma ment to be
repaidfrom the net revenues from the tournament; and
WHEREAS, the City and Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball each fulfilled all of their
respective responsibilities under the agreement to sponsor and host the2017 Tournament; and
WHEREAS, Steve Avila failed his responsibility to bring 16 teams to the 2017
Tournament, despite his repeated promises and assurances that there would be16 qualified teams
from the westerm United States and Canada attending the 2017 Tournament; and
WHEREAS, following Mr.Avila's failure to provide the teams for the2017Toumament,
Mr.Avila expressly promised that he would repay the Cityand Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball for
theirlosses sustained from the2017 Tournament, including the$50,000.00invested by the City;
pue
WHEREAS, Mr. Avila has failed or refused to repay those sums to the City and
Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball; and
WHEREAS, in January 2018, Steve Avila and SAA Enterprises proposed another
agreement with the City whereby Mr.Avila would conduct a CABA 18U wood bat world series
on the City's fields during the summer of 2018; and
WHEREAS, on February 12,2018, the Governing Body rejected Mr.Avila's proposal
for a 2018 tournament on the City's fields by a unanimous 10-0 vote.Mr.Avila failed to
1:
appear at the February 12, 2018 council meeting to address the issues from the 2017 Tourmament
and did not communicate any reason for his absence; and
WHEREAS, subsequent to the Governing Body's unanimous rejection of Mr. Avila's
proposal for a 2018 tournament on the City's fields, Mr.Avila submitted an application to rent
the City's fields to hold aCABA tournament on those same dates in 2018 anyway, despite the
fact that he has still not repaid the City and Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball for the losses sustained
by them from the2017Tournament; and
WHEREAS, the City's published written policies and procedures governing the rental of
City athletic fields expressly state that“the Cityof Cheyenne rents the Athletic Fields when it is
in the best interests of the community."; and
WHEREAS, it is not in the best interests of the community to allow Mr.Avila or SAA
Enterprises torent the City's athletic fields without Mr.Avila repaying the City and Cheyenne
Mustangs Baseball for the losses those parties sustained from the 2017 Tournament as a result of
Mr. Avila's failures.
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVEDBY THE GOVERNING BODYOF THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING AS FOLLOWS:
1.The City hereby finds that it is not in the best interest of the community to rent the
City's athletic fields to Steve Avila or SAA Enterprises due to the circumstances described in the
foregoing recitals.
2. Steve Avila, SAA Enterprises, LLC, or any parties associated therewith, are
hereby precluded from renting or using the City's athletic fields until those parties have repaid
the City and Cheyenne Mustangs Baseball for all losses sustained from the 2017 Tournament,
including but not limited to the $50,000.00 paid by the City.Mr.Avila's hold on the City's
fieldsshall be immediately released.
3.The officers and members of the G over ming Body of the City and the employees
thereof are hereby authorized and directed to take all action necessary or appropriate to
effectuate the provisions of this Resolution.
